mapper.select:
SELECT b.branch_code AS id, b.name, r.name AS region, b.address, b.phone, b.status, e.name AS managerName, e.phone AS managerPhone, e.email AS managerEmail, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE branch_code = b.branch_code) AS employeeCount FROM branch b LEFT JOIN region r ON b.region_code = r.region_code LEFT JOIN employee e ON b.branch_code = e.branch_code AND e.position_code = 'POS_MGR'
b.branch_code != 1
AND r.name = #{region}
AND ( b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO branch (branch_code, region_code, name, address, phone, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{regionCode}, #{name}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE branch SET region_code = #{regionCode}, name = #{name}, address = #{address}, phone = #{phone}, status = #{status} WHERE branch_code = #{id}
